people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
translations.bsb: He said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.” (That is why he was also called Edom.)
translations.kjv: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
translations.asv: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage. For I am faint. Therefore was his name called Edom.
